detail.longDescription:
Meet your personal team of AI agents. Ask anything, build anything, learn anything — all in one beautifully simple app.

Agentic AI is the fastest way to get expert help from smart agents built for real tasks. Write emails in your voice, debug code, plan a trip, draft a pitch, or research a topic — every agent is an expert at what it does, and they actually work together.

Agentic AI is free to download and includes 3 free tasks so you can try it. Continued use, saved custom agents, and multi-agent team sessions require a paid Agentic AI PRO subscription.

WHY AGENTIC AI IS DIFFERENT

Most AI apps give you one generic assistant. Agentic AI gives you an entire team of specialists you can put to work — individually or together. Pick one expert for a focused task, or build a team of up to four and watch them collaborate in real time, each adding its own expertise. (Team sessions require a PRO subscription.)

BUILT-IN EXPERT AGENTS

• General Assistant — your everyday helper for any question
• Writing Coach — emails, essays, captions, blog posts, cover letters
• Code Helper — write, explain, debug, refactor in any language
• Research Analyst — deep answers with clear reasoning and context
• Creative Brainstormer — ideas, names, hooks, stories, campaigns
• Study Buddy — tutor, summarize, explain any subject
• Translator — natural, context-aware translation across languages
• Life Planner — goals, schedules, decisions, daily priorities

Your 3 free tasks work with any of these agents. Continued use requires a PRO subscription.

BUILD YOUR OWN AGENTS (REQUIRES PRO SUBSCRIPTION)

Create fully custom agents with your own persona, tone, and expertise — your workflow, your brand, your voice. Saving agents and creating unlimited agents require PRO.

MULTI-AGENT TEAM SESSIONS (REQUIRES PRO SUBSCRIPTION)

This is where Agentic AI shines. Assemble a team — a Writer plus a Strategist plus a Researcher — and get a complete plan in one session. The agents read each other's answers, add unique value, and skip repeating what has already been said. Real collaboration, not parallel chatter.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your conversations never train anyone's model. No accounts. No login. Your data lives on your device, in your control.

WHAT PEOPLE LOVE

• Instant, expert-level answers across any subject
• Natural, human-quality writing in your own voice
• Real code that actually runs
• Thoughtful research you can trust
• Beautiful, distraction-free interface
• Works the moment you open the app

PERFECT FOR

Students, writers, developers, founders, marketers, researchers, creators, and anyone who wants a smarter helper in their pocket.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Draft an email that sounds like you
• Turn a rough idea into a full business plan
• Debug a tricky piece of code
• Summarize a long document in seconds
• Translate a message naturally
• Generate names, taglines, and hooks
• Plan your week, goals, or next trip
• Learn any subject from first principles
• Brainstorm with an entire team of experts

AGENTIC AI PRO — PAID SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED

Agentic AI is free to download and includes 3 free tasks. A paid PRO subscription unlocks:

• 100 tasks per day
• Unlimited custom agents you can save and reuse
• Multi-agent team sessions
• All future PRO features

Subscription options:
• PRO Weekly — $9.99 per week
• PRO Annual — $34.99 per year

Credit packs are available as separate one-time in-app purchases for power users who need extra capacity on top of the daily PRO allowance.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://whatisagenticai.net/app-privacy/
